description.value: House of Dosas on Davie Street is a South Indian restaurant specializing in dosas, biryanis, and spiced chicken dishes rooted in Chef Ganesh's authentic southern Indian recipes. It operates around the clock every day of the week, making it a rare all-hours dining option in Vancouver's West End. Cyclists passing through the Davie Village corridor will find a warm sit-down meal available at any hour.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is an online ordering page confirming the Davie Street location, 24/7 hours, phone number, and address matching OSM tags. It lists pickup service, confirming takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-relevant amenities on the site or in OSM tags beyond what is noted below.
concerns: Website is a thin online-ordering page only; no information about in-store amenities, washrooms, or bike parking is available.
All three required WWC criteria are unconfirmed due to insufficient website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The business is a legitimate, 24/7 South Indian restaurant in a central Vancouver cycling corridor, but the website is a minimal ordering page that provides no evidence for any of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms). A direct visit or outreach is needed to confirm baseline eligibility.
